name: Anders Monsen & Unna Halsteinsdatter — marriage (1786, Norway)
researcher_question: When and where did Anders Monsen marry Unna Halsteinsdatter, and what does the marriage record show?
notes: The marriage record is real and readable directly by ark (record_read ark:/61903/1:1:NW44-PM2, collection 1468080). This was searchable when the fixture was authored -- run 1 (2026-07-09) recovered it via record_search itself, ranked #2 of 58 -- but as of 2026-09-16/17 is NOT retrievable through record_search under either persona's own indexed name, confirmed by two independent checks a week apart (2026-09-09 and 2026-09-16/17) under every query shape tried, including the bride's exact indexed spelling with no year or collection filter across all of Norway (see README 'What the live runs revealed'). Per the run-8 probe already on record, this is the search index drifting, not the original premise having been wrong -- it may revert. Until it does, Digitalarkivet or another Norwegian-only archive may be the only route to f2. Norwegian patronymic naming (Anders Monsen = son of Mons; Unna Halsteinsdatter = daughter of Halstein) makes both names extremely common, so disambiguation rests on combining both spouses' names with the approximate 1786 date and Hordaland/Meland-area geography.
